### Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

### Guideline Checklists

#### 🌿 Branch Naming & Commits
- [ ] My branch name starts with one of the allowed prefixes:
  - `feat/feature-name` (for new features)
  - `fix/bug-desc` (for bug fixes)
  - `docs/doc-updates` (for documentation changes)
  - `refactor/code-improvement` (for code quality updates)
- [ ] My commits are small, clean, and well-described.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the structured pattern (e.g., `feat(cache): add redis cluster support` or `fix(limiter): resolve off-by-one error`).

#### ✅ Quality Assurance
- [ ] My code follows the existing style and architecture.
- [ ] I have tested these changes locally (e.g., using a local Redis server or the in-memory mock client).
- [ ] I have executed the integration/regression test scripts successfully.
- [ ] My changes do not expose any sensitive environment variables, credentials, or keys.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation or `README.md` if necessary.
